policies.title: Macao SAR passports: eVisa for Angola, Burkina Faso, Guinea and São Tomé and Príncipe
policies.summary: Macao DSI's current passport-specific country records expressly classify each listed destination's visitor route as eVisa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Macao SAR Passport, not a PRC national passport, Hong Kong SAR passport, Macao travel permit, residence document or special passport.
DSI's exact country records classify the route as eVisa; their linked destination services must be used before travel.
Purpose, validity, fees, entry points, carrier checks and final admission remain governed by the destination authority.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: visa-free visitor entry for Grenada, Georgia, North Macedonia and Vanuatu
policies.summary: Macao DSI's current passport-specific country records directly classify the listed destinations as visa-free.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Macao SAR Passport, not a PRC national passport, Hong Kong SAR passport, Macao travel permit, residence document or special passport.
The DSI records state maximum stays of 90 days for Grenada and North Macedonia, and 30 days for Georgia and Vanuatu.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Macau visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Macao SAR Passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.
